text:
Low carbohydrate intake may impair high-intensity exercise performance because it reduces the availability of muscle and liver glycogen, which are critical fuel sources for such activities. This dietary approach forces the body to rely more heavily on fat oxidation, a process that cannot sustain maximal power output or speed as effectively as carbohydrate metabolism. Consequently, athletes engaging in intense training often experience diminished endurance and strength when their carb stores are depleted.
CONFIDENCE: 95
